children: ICICI Securities's research report on Awfis Space Solutions

Awfis Space Solutions (Awfis) delivered 20% YoY revenue growth in Q2FY27, with IGAAP EBITDA growing 50% YoY to INR 0.5bn (basis revised cash EBITDA calculation methodology). As of Sep’26, Awfis has 164,000+ operational seats and guides to close FY27 with ~170,000 operational seats. In H1FY27, the company has restated its H1FY26 cash EBITDA calculations (IGAAP equivalent) to reflect the entire cash rental payments to landlords. Accordingly, we have recalibrated our FY26-27 and FY27-28E IGAAP estimates to reflect these changes. We retain our BUY rating with a revised TP of INR 384, post the new accounting calculation for IGAAP EBITDA valuing the company on 12x Sep’27E EV/IGAAP EBITDA. Key risks: Office leasing slowdown and competition within flexspaces.

The company is targeting exit margins of ~12% by Mar’27 and expects to clock 12%+ margins going forward. We now estimate FY27/FY28 cash EBITDA of INR 1.9/INR 2.5bn with margins of 10.8/12.3%. Retain BUY with a revised TP of INR 384, based on 12x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA.
